summary: Multi-tenant digest subscriptions: subscriber list backed by Vercel Postgres, replacing the single hardcoded DIGEST_CHAT_ID/DIGEST_COIN_SYMBOLS. Code (feat b3d5ddb + e2e fix fc70c49) already shipped to master before this epic's paper trail was written retroactively. verify.md: fail (5/10 AC untested, all due to no scratch DB + missing SubscribersService/DigestController unit tests, not real defects). review.md: hold-retroactively/ship-at-HEAD (1 blocker already fixed one commit later, 2 should-fix: no feature-branch/PR used, chat_id has no max length before being persisted). Not yet deployed — docs/DEPLOYMENT.md step 3a (attach Postgres, run migration, seed legacy recipient) still outstanding. Maintain phase not run: no production signal exists yet.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Chose @neondatabase/serverless over @vercel/postgres (deprecated) for the Postgres/Neon connection.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Neon HTTP driver (neon()), not a pooled client — matches serverless/no-long-lived-connection architecture.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Success metric (intent.md): >=1 subscriber other than the original DIGEST_CHAT_ID recipient active within 30 days of production deploy.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Follow-up work needed before this epic is fully clean: subscribers.service.spec.ts (AC09), digest.controller.spec.ts (AC07), e2e case for DEFAULT_WATCHLIST fallback (AC02), chat_id @MaxLength on ZaloWebhookChatDto (review finding #3).

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: This epic's artifacts were written retroactively after the code already shipped (see intent.md provenance note) -- verify.md/review.md independence is caveated as a result.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Closed 3 of verify.md's 5 untested ACs (AC02 default-watchlist e2e, AC07 digest isolation, AC09 watchlist validation) via subscribers.service.spec.ts + digest.controller.spec.ts + 1 new e2e case, commit 41e4e93. Unit suite now 63 tests (was 46), e2e now 11 (was 10).

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: AC04 (upsert reactivation) and AC08 (seed-script idempotency) still untested -- both require a real Postgres instance, not available in this environment. AC04's query shape is proven via a mocked Neon driver. Real proof for both is naturally covered by the first production deploy (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md step 3a).

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Closed AC04/AC08 (the last 2 untested ACs) with real Postgres execution: spun up a scratch postgres:16-alpine Docker container, applied the real migration via psql, ran subscribe()'s and db-seed-digest-subscriber.js's exact ON CONFLICT upsert SQL twice each, confirmed no duplicates, then removed the container. verify.md is now PASS 10/10.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Deployed to production 2026-09-22: Vercel Postgres (Neon) attached by owner, db:migrate + db:seed-digest-subscriber run against real production DB, code deployed via 'vercel deploy --prod'. /health confirmed ok.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Found a THIRD real bug only during actual deployment (outside spec.md's original ACs): db-migrate.js sent a whole multi-statement .sql file to Neon's HTTP driver in one sql.query() call -- rejected ('cannot insert multiple commands into a prepared statement'). The scratch-psql verification done for AC04/AC08 used 'psql -f' which handles multi-statement files fine, masking this. Fixed by splitting each migration file into individual statements (PR #2, commit 0115944).

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Lesson: verifying a script's SQL logic via psql is not equivalent to verifying the SCRIPT ITSELF against the real driver it uses in production. Future DB scripts should be smoke-tested with the actual driver (even against a scratch/mock endpoint) before being marked verified, not just the underlying SQL.

reflections.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
reflections.text: Retrofitting an ai-native epic onto already-shipped code is valuable: writing spec.md surfaced a real broken-CI bug (POSTGRES_URL missing from e2e env setup) that had gone unnoticed because npm test and npm run test:e2e are separate commands and only the former was run after the original implementation. Next time: run the FULL command suite (unit + e2e + build) before considering any feature done, not just unit tests.

reflections.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
reflections.text: Retroactive verify/review caught 2 of 3 real bugs (e2e boot break, missing test coverage) before deploy, but missed a 3rd (multi-statement SQL vs Neon's HTTP driver) because the scratch-DB proof used psql directly instead of running the actual script under test. Next time: always execute the real script/tool being verified, not just its underlying SQL, against the scratch environment.
